meaning: The Hall core of a subgroup M (the product of its normal Sylow subgroups), seen as a subgroup of the ambient group; previously defined five times under different names.

For subgroups W, W1, W2 of G, the set D = W \ (W1 ∪ W2) has stabilizer exactly W under conjugation and is a TI set relative to W: every conjugate of D by an element outside W is disjoint from D. IsCyclicTIPair now extends this predicate.
Irr G is the set of irreducible complex characters of a group G: the functions G → ℂ that are characters of some finite-dimensional irreducible complex representation of G.

StageK is the conjunction of all global results of the odd order proof whose dependency depth is at most K, built as a chain of Prop structures each extending the previous one; a chapter result at depth K+1 is proved under the single assumption StageK ("all earlier results hold"), and the main theorem assembles stage1, stage2, … in order.
